note.zh-TW: 0-2 以 ME 代表；網站補充的延伸科目，給 ME intensity 等指標使用。台灣報表多列在推銷費用。
note.en: Represented by ME in the 0-2 slides; an extension account added by the site for ratios such as marketing expense intensity. Taiwanese statements usually show it under distribution costs.

definition.zh-TW: 廣告、促銷等推廣產品的費用。它屬於銷管費用。
definition.en: Advertising, promotion and similar costs of marketing the products. It belongs to distribution and administrative expenses.
